name: Privileged Logon Then WMI Persistence Registered
description: Special privileges are assigned to a logon (4672) and a permanent WMI event consumer is then registered (5861) — a fileless persistence mechanism that survives reboot and leaves nothing in the usual autorun locations. 5861 needs the WMI-Activity operational channel ingested; 4672 fires on essentially every administrative or SYSTEM logon, so it is a broad anchor and the pairing is a lead to inspect, not a finding on its own.
